For a man visiting Williamsburg or settling in the area, WCC is worth investigating directly — evaluate the current pastor, the specific doctrinal commitments, gender polity of the elder board, and preaching content before committing.

churches.assessment: The Woodlands Methodist Church is the single largest church in the Global Methodist Church — 14,000 members who voted 96% to depart the UMC and join the GMC in 2023. That kind of institutional courage (leaving a denomination with all the attendant property and legal costs) signals a congregation serious about orthodox Wesleyan teaching. Rev. Mark Sorensen took over as Senior Pastor from the long-tenured Rev. Dr. Ed Robb in 2021, holds an M.Div from Asbury Theological Seminary, and has served the church since 2013. The church operates two campuses in the Houston suburbs, runs a preschool and a private elementary school, and offers 10 live and online worship services weekly. As with all GMC churches, the local stance on women as elders should be verified (the Texas conference varies), but the overall profile is solidly orthodox, Trinitarian, traditional-marriage Wesleyan.

It is a congregation of the Free Church of Scotland (Continuing) — a denomination that holds to Biblical inerrancy and the original Westminster Confession of Faith without modification. This is not the touchy-feely mainline PCUSA Presbyterian; this is hard-core Westminster Calvinist confessionalism. Pastor Rom Prakashpalan is a converted Hindu/atheist who came to faith through hearing the Gospel (Romans 10:17), graduated RPTS with an MDiv, and was installed here in November 2024. The lack of men's ministry is understandable for a plant this young. For a man who wants unapologetic Reformed confessionalism and a pastor with a powerful conversion testimony, this is a must-visit.

churches.assessment: Truth Bible Church is an independent Baptist Bible church in Hollywood, Maryland (Southern Maryland), planted in 2008 and now led by Dr. Joshua West, who holds a Th.M and a Th.D in systematic theology from Trinity College of the Bible and Theological Seminary. Its statement of faith affirms the inerrancy of Scripture, the Trinity, orthodox Christology (virgin birth, physical resurrection, substitutionary atonement), and salvation by grace alone through faith alone, with believer's baptism by immersion. The church is governed by a plurality of male elders (Dr. Joshua West, Dr. Alden Laird, Dr. Dennis Richardson, and Dan Ensminger), with no women in pastoral or elder roles and distinct Men of Truth and Women of Truth ministries, which places it clearly in complementarian practice; discipleship runs through Home Groups and one-to-one counseling, and missions are pursued both locally and through Pastor West's work with the church-planting ministry Compel International. The clearest signal comes from West's own published theology: Hard Sayings: Reconciling the Cost of Discipleship and the American Dream and Come and Die press a costly, counter-consumerist discipleship and openly reject the feel-good preaching that never calls sinners to repentance, while The Power of Preaching and his verse-by-verse Romans volumes point to expository, doctrinally serious preaching. The church website (Wix) is sparse and was mid-transition, but the leadership page, an active Facebook (TBCMaryland) and Instagram presence, and the pastor's substantial public writing together substantiate a green rating rather than a default yellow.

churches.assessment: Christ Church is a CREC (Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches) congregation meeting in Morrisville, North Carolina, led by Pastor Duane Garner — an ACBC-certified biblical counselor who also serves as Presiding Minister of the CREC’s Augustine Presbytery. It is confessional and covenantal: the Bible is “absolutely authoritative,” the historic Reformed confessions and catechisms are its doctrinal summary, worship follows the covenant-renewal pattern with Psalm-singing, and the congregation is governed by a plurality of male elders and deacons. Its culture is family-integrated, classically educated, and robustly counter-secular. An acquaintance of MOOP recommended it as “super solid” — free of the wokeness, CRT, and female-leadership concerns this directory screens for. It earns green across all ten categories.

An acquaintance of MOOP whose family attends describes the pastor as excellent and the culture as explicitly patriarchal and family-integrated, with head coverings common among the women and a large contingent of young families; the fellowship meals are a highlight and the main critique is simply a lengthy service. It earns green across all ten categories. churches.assessment: Citylight Church Dover is a new Citylight plant in Dover, York County, Pennsylvania. It began gathering in 2026 and meets Sundays at 4:00 PM at 6390 Harmony Grove Road, Dover, PA 17315. Their site names Andy Resh as the lead planter: MTS and STM from Grimke Seminary, planter and former lead pastor of Citylight Delco. Alex Kocman, an elder at Faith Bible Fellowship Church of York and a staff member at ABWE, has publicly said he and his family are preparing to transition here over the coming months. He will help lead worship and enter a season of pastoral development. He is staying at ABWE. He is not the lead pastor of this church. The move is on good terms with the elders at Faith, not a conflict. Public distinctives include gospel centrality, God's sovereignty in saving sinners, continuationist spiritual gifts, complementarian leadership, and believer's baptism. This listing is from those public pages and from Kocman's public update. Sermons have not been reviewed, so this is Visit with Discernment, not a full green. To support their ministry, their site says give at https://citylightdover.com/give/ and select Citylight York. Faith Bible Fellowship page: https://usmcmin.org/churches/faith-bible-fellowship-york-pa.html
